documents.title: AI Resources (incl. Generative AI Guidance for Privacy and Security)
documents.stance_why: The page does not set a classroom rule. It says ChatGPT "use is permitted" with memory settings changed, lists supported AI tools, and says student AI use on assignments "is not ideal", with detection tools offered. Overall it is conditional permission, so permit.
documents.summary: IT Services page on AI risks (cybersecurity, privacy, ethics), BGSU-supported AI tools, and tools to detect or prevent AI use in coursework. Mostly privacy and security guidance; no coursework rule is set.
